scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && vite build apps/web && concurrently -k -n web,api "vite build apps/web --watch" "wrangler dev --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p scripts
scripts.test: eslint apps/web && vitest run --config apps/api/vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --project unit && vitest run --config scripts/vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --project unit && vitest run --config apps/api/vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --project integration --project production-gate && vitest run --config scripts/vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --project integration && vitest run --config apps/web/vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --config apps/api/vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --project unit && vitest run --config scripts/vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --project unit && vitest run --config apps/web/vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --project web-unit
scripts.test:integration: vitest run --config apps/api/vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --project integration --project production-gate && vitest run --config scripts/vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --project integration
